##: The Windows release asset is a flat ZIP with DeSmuME_0.9.13_x64.exe at the root; no extract_dir or installer hooks are needed.
The executable name embeds the version, so pre_install renames it to DeSmuME_x64.exe before shims and shortcuts are created; this keeps them valid after an upgrade.
Release tags use underscores (release_0_9_13) while asset filenames use dots, so checkver converts the tag to 0.9.13 and autoupdate uses $underscoreVersion in the tag path.
The Windows frontend writes desmume.ini in its working directory, so that file is persisted across upgrades.
The release asset has no published digest, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and Excavator downloads the archive to compute its SHA-256.
